source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Lighthouse Keeper
tts_text: The keeper had to adopt a routine no one else would want. In his free hours he had little to amuse him, and the sea could still amaze a man who had watched it for forty years. A sudden wave might startle him, but that was his only pastime and his only recreation. His choices were not randomly made, and never arbitrary. He could alter the lamp, or he could find an alternative: to shift the lens a little and let the beam turn. The change was swift. Weather in these parts will vary, and one thing was variable while another stayed invariably the same. The little model boat on his shelf was the only thing he would modify, and his needs were modest. He was earnest about the work, and moderate in his habits, ready to tolerate anything but a lazy hand. Light can be slight, or it can enlighten a whole coast. During lightning and thunder he would stay at the window with delight, never in plight, never with blight. At dawn the lamp would alight once more.

sentences_cn: 守塔人不得不养成一种别人不愿要的作息。

他的选择不是随便做的，也从不随心所欲。
他可以把灯改一改，或者找另一种办法：把镜片挪一点，让光柱转起来。
这一带天气会变，有一样可变，另一样却始终不变。

电闪雷鸣时他会欣喜地守在窗前，从不陷入困境，也从不消沉。
